items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, affiliate expansion, advertising, and notification expansion. COUNSEL_REQUIRED for upstream redistribution rights and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment. Recommendation: keep the service private, leave rights outreach unsent, and permit only bounded read-only evidence work. Fleet compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and owner gates remain unresolved. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active at 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. No task is closed because completion evidence is missing. Current progress: source-rights evidence confirms an access mechanism only; data-flow evidence is partial; consent/analytics evidence is partial; logs, vendor, and incident evidence remain open. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle containing the repository/config data-flow and retention table, deployed consent and withdrawal capture, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, log-field/access inventory, vendor terms or DPA status, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is COUNSEL_REQUIRED because current evidence does not establish public display, storage, historical derivatives, alerts, affiliate, advertising, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights. User alert rules and sync results are EVIDENCE_NEEDED because retention, deletion, access, correction, processor, consent, and unsubscribe evidence is absent. GA4 analytics is EVIDENCE_NEEDED because deployed consent behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdictional review are not evidenced. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are EVIDENCE_NEEDED because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures are not evidenced.

The candidate plan's proposed rodhat.com SEO and scaffold launch-readiness work may remain planning-only, but no new implementation admission or public exposure is cleared. The existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement remains conditionally retainable after capacity and site-overlap clearance, provided disclosures, consent behavior, destinations, tracking, and claims remain unchanged. Revenue evidence supports no site-level ROI or commission claim: the available $4.92 is aggregate and unattributed.

Concrete blocker for private or gated launch: the owner must select keep-private or bounded-beta only after the four legal evidence tasks, security/CTO/CFO gates, and human-counsel questions are resolved. The next decision is not a generic owner check-in: complete the dated evidence bundle, then record whether upstream permission exists and whether the owner confirms continued private status.
